Product Features

  • The precise size fits perfectly: with dimensions of 50 x 100 x 46 cm, it is pleasantly compact and space-saving. It fits perfectly into various living rooms and does not look bulky due to its low weight.
  • Multifunctional, height-adjustable tabletop: The tabletop can be flexibly adjusted from a starting height of 46 cm to a maximum height of 60 cm, making it easy to switch between coffee table, side table and temporary desk, maximising its flexibility.
  • Multi-layered storage with large capacity: An integrated hidden storage compartment, adjustable dividers on the side divide the storage space into two levels, and an open bottom compartment provide ample space. Ideal for storing tea sets, books and other small items – for a tidy living room.
  • Gently curved, aesthetic design: The edges and corners of the cabinet are softly rounded, eliminating hard edges. The lines are warm and elegant, and the plain white gives it a refined and sophisticated touch, contributing to a stylish ambience in your home.
  • Sturdy Metal Legs: Equipped with two iron table legs, this table offers a high load capacity. The recommended total load is 35 kg. The sturdy construction does not wobble, allowing for safe storage of heavy objects in daily use.
  • Flexible and customizable layered storage: The side storage space is equipped with adjustable shelves that can be freely adjusted according to the height of the items to be stored, to accommodate items of different sizes, making storage more practical.
  • Clever hidden storage compartment: The fold-up tabletop has an integrated, hidden storage compartment that is perfect for storing personal items and small items. When closed, the tabletop looks neat and elegant, combining cleanliness and functionality.
  • High-quality board material, durable and eco-friendly: The whole construction is made of high-quality chipboard, which is sturdy, has a smooth and easy-to-clean surface, is wear-resistant and durable, and is not prone to deformation or cracking even after many years of use.
  • Versatile coffee table in cream style: With its pure white, minimalist design, this coffee table combines multifunctional height adjustment with various storage options and fits perfectly with modern, cream and Scandinavian interior styles. It serves both as a practical coffee table and as a stylish decorative element for your living room.
  • Note: Due to different shooting conditions and display devices, there may be slight color variations between the actual product and the image. This is normal and not a quality defect. We strive to display the product color as faithfully as possible. Please only order if this is important to you.

Descriptions

Descriptions

Total dimensions: 50 x 100 x 46 cm. This height-adjustable coffee table for the living room can be adjusted up to a height of 60 cm. It offers hidden storage, a perforated storage compartment, an elegant curved design and two side storage compartments with adjustable shelves. The table top (partly height-adjustable) stands on two iron legs. The recommended load capacity is 35 kg. The table is white and made of chipboard.
